title: Nature NFT Marketplace Event POAP
tagline: We designed, created and dropped a POAP to celebrate attendance at our Nature NFT Marketplace virtual trade show.
description: We designed, created and dropped a POAP to commemorate attendance at a virtual trade show as a marketing tool to drive traffic to our Nature NFT Marketplace https://nature-nfts-marketplace-polygon.vercel.app/. The POAP would be awarded to participants in the trade show who either purchased an NFT or bid on any of the listings. We haven't held a trade show yet, but plan to in the near future.
how_its_made: The "Nature NFTs Marketplace" logo was created using Canva and the POAP was created using Photoshop where the .psdc file was converted to a .png file. The .png file was uploaded to https://app.poap.xyz/admin/events/new to Create a Drop. Information regarding the description of the event, number of POAPs in the drop, schedule of the drop were uploaded to https://app.poap.xyz/admin/events/new. In 2-3 hours, the Event was approved and the test drop was conducted with friends and family who were able to either access the POAP with their ETH address, ENS address or email addresses.
